areas.t: Today, as an upper-level trough of low pressure passes over the region, mixing will be enhanced. In addition, rain showers and moderate to gusty westerly surface winds will disperse pollutants. Therefore, AQI levels will be Good.  Tomorrow, mixing will decrease as a ridge of high pressure aloft move
